build_scripted_game_master: build a scripted game master agent using the GameMaster prefab with a provided script and language model
create_game_master_prefab: create a GameMaster prefab instance with a name, script list, and optional verbose flag
configure_script_component: configure a Script component that drives the game master action spec, termination, resolution, and observation
setup_next_acting_order: set up a NextActingInFixedOrder component using entity names extracted from the script entries
review_game_master_build: review the GameMaster build method to understand how it assembles components and returns an EntityAgentWithLogging
